text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer!
I'm done with my cool-down!”
choice_data_list: Good work! How are you feeling today?

text_block_list.text:
"I observe her running form and ask Buena Vista for her thoughts before adjusting the next menu.
Training is going smoothly today too!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You've built up your stamina, too.
All right, let's head out once you've changed.
To our promised Hachimi...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. A reward for all our hard work together, right?
I've been looking forward to this since last week.
Hehehe—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...They're really close.
Must be nice, having a bond like that.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?
Troubled about your relationship with your Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, honestly...
You get along so well with your Trainer, Buena-chan.
Hey, how can I be like that too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I always end up saying things in such an unpleasant way.
But just keeping quiet and putting up with it isn't right either...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We're always clashing...
If this keeps up, maybe one day
she'll just abandon me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No way...!
To be abandoned, of all things...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's just too painful...
You'd really, really agonize over that...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-You understand...!?
It might sound exaggerated, but I'm really scared...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... Thanks...
I think talking about it helped me feel a bit better.
Al-Alright, gotta cheer up~...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...No, please don't push yourself so hard.
Putting on a brave face just makes it sadder..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there something I can do too...?
Just listening to her won't solve anything, right...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: B-Buena-chan……!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hrrrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um... Could you give me a moment?
I want to help...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
............
The way I said it...? No...
Clashing with each other isn't... necessarily bad...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Her Trainer...
I've talked to them before too...
and they were a truly wonderful person..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're smiling... They seem kind...
It really was just a minor misunderstanding... after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The Ultimate Art of Communication"...
"Secrets to Sharing Your Opinion Without Getting Emotional..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Mumu...
Looks like every book essentially boils down to
"sincerity is key"...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
Being open and honest... I know she can do it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Alright...!

—One day, I spotted Buena Vista talking with a friend.
It seemed she was giving her some advice.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I seeee... Honesty really is the best policy, huh...
But if our opinions differ,
won't we just end up clashing anyway...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, first I'll try telling them.
That I want to talk things out, not fight.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"You don't actually want them
to back down, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Right... But...
If they don't understand,
won't it just get more complicated?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Even so...
If you're truly sincere, I'm sure it'll get through to them."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We're running in races together, so of course we're going to disagree sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why you shouldn't be afraid of clashing.
If you speak from the heart with trust, they'll understand."
choice_data_list: (That really hits the nail on the head...)

text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista has always been like this.
Facing those who are troubled or struggling head-on, guiding them toward a solution through sincere dialogue...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
For giving such great advice on this.
Though... I wonder if it'll go well...?

Her friend still seemed hesitant.
Wanting to give her that final push, I chimed in.
choice_data_list: They're bumping into you because they're giving it their all, too.
Maybe try chatting with them first?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right. If I ever started straying down the wrong path,
I believe my Trainer would stop me, even if they had to tackle me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't you think so too,
Trainer?

Her friend nodded in understanding.
Seeing that, Buena Vista—having faced the issue head-on—looked delighted.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I see. True, once you have a relationship where you can talk casually, it might be easier to bring up important things too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: “I see... Yeah, thank you! I'll give it a try. I'm heading right over to the Trainer's office!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, there she goes.
Even if they clash, she's still someone precious to her.
After all, she was worrying so much over it...
